notes: {"answer":"Call 911 now. Ribs pulling in with each breath, fast labored breathing and bluish lips mean your child isn't getting enough air. Stay with them and keep them calm and upright.","triage":"Call 911 now - don't drive them yourself, and don't wait for 811. Go to the ER only if 911 can't reach you.
